title: Hyper Real
description: A Modpack that makes Minecraft feel more real and immersive.

# 🌍 Hyper Real

Hyper Real is a visual-focused Minecraft modpack that transforms the game into a more realistic and immersive experience.

With Shaders and enhanced environments, the world feels more alive while trying to keep the core Minecraft gameplay still intact.

## ❤️ Note

**All mods belong to their respective creators.
If you enjoy this modpack, please consider supporting the original developers!**

## ✨ Features
🌄 Realistic lighting, shadows, and reflections
🌿 Improved terrain and foliage
🌊 Better water (WIP), sky, and atmosphere
🎨 Clean, detailed visual style
⚙️ Performance

Designed to look great while staying playable on mid to high-end PCs.

### 🎮 Perfect for
Exploration
Building
Screenshots & videos

### 🚀 Summary

A simple way to make Minecraft look cleaner, more realistic, and more immersive—without changing how it plays, kinda like [Better MC](https://modrinth.com/modpack/better-mc-fabric-bmc2)

**🐞 Report issues here: https://spaceoncoffee.carrd.co/**
